subject: H Mart Site Plan Approval
overview: The Community Development Board approved a site plan for an H Mart grocery store, recommended proposed zoning ordinance amendments to the City Council, and received an update on MBTA Communities overlay planning.

items.title: Site Plan Review for 285-295 Middlesex Avenue
items.summary: Approved the site plan for an H Mart grocery store at Townline Plaza with conditions regarding pedestrian safety, native landscaping, employee parking, and MassDOT coordination.

items.title: Special Permit Continuance for 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway
items.summary: Continued the special permit application for 3850 Mystic Valley Parkway to September 6, 2023, at the applicant's request.

items.title: Proposed Zoning Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Recommended approval of city-sponsored zoning ordinance amendments to the City Council, with additions to designate the Community Development Board as the special permit granting authority for specified C2 commercial uses and restore missing zoning definitions.

items.title: Board Elections
items.summary: Elected Peter Calves as board clerk and Ari Fishman as the representative to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from July 5, 2023, and July 19, 2023, subject to a minor clerical completion.

items.title: MBTA Communities Zoning Update
items.summary: Received a status report from planning staff on the draft MBTA Communities multi-family overlay district centered near the Wellington Orange Line station ahead of a planned September public input meeting.

items.title: Planning Department Updates
items.summary: Received updates from staff on upcoming project applications, recent City Council zoning actions, and development proposals across the city.
